# Official-family test fixtures

Offline inputs for `tests/test_fetch_official.py`, shaped like the live pages observed on 2026-10-10 and reduced to the fields the adapters read: App Store `serialized-server-data` shelves, iTunes lookup results for two storefronts, Google Play listings in two locales (screenshot `srcset` resize suffixes), a TapTap `__NUXT_DATA__` devalue payload (banner served as a crop/resize rendition), an X embed timeline (`__NEXT_DATA__`) with a partner retweet and a Universe post, and a SoundCloud `/tracks` page that server-renders 3 of the account's 5 tracks (`soundcloud_tracks.html`). Identifiers are partly synthetic.
